confirmed_contracts: Selection does not evaluate callbacks or allocate numerical workspaces; dimensions/tolerances are validated by solve separately.
Unknown/Nonstiff selects DOPRI5 without derivative callbacks. Stiff requires explicit derivative authorization.
ProvidedOnly rejects the default finite-difference Jacobian and a missing nonautonomous partial time derivative.
Dense callbacks with declared bands still count against max_dense_dimension; JVP/GMRES requires explicit permission and inherits unsupported-vector-atol refusal.
The explicit scoped session keeps one native workspace, controller, FSAL cache, fixed landing schedule and cumulative attempt budget across pauses.
Native RHS stage buffers are poisoned; successful callbacks with unwritten/nonfinite output are fatal, while recoverable callback failures are charged and may retry.
Only accepted state is exposed by checkpoint; sticky terminal state prevents later callbacks.
Early return from the driver retains the last accepted physical state and returns success=false rather than claiming completed integration.
The refreshed native session lookup uses binary search on OutputSchedule finite strictly-increasing times; partial_cmp retains signed-zero equality and does not change membership semantics.

nonblocking_limits.detail: The new selection surface does not detect stiffness or switch within a solve. Unknown means a budgeted explicit attempt, not automatic stiff capability.
nonblocking_limits.required_reporting: Describe explicit regime selection; keep adaptive switching as a separate opt-in API.

nonblocking_limits.detail: max_dense_dimension excludes compact band storage; a wide band can still consume quadratic storage and large factorization work.
nonblocking_limits.next_step: Consider a separately specified byte/work ceiling based on dimension and bandwidth, with checked integer arithmetic; do not advertise the current dense cap as a total memory budget.

nonblocking_limits.detail: Epoch checks catch declared model/provider/norm/tolerance changes only; interior mutation hidden by the caller cannot be detected.
nonblocking_limits.required_reporting: Require stable callbacks and a reconstructed session after a declared change.

nonblocking_limits.detail: Forward spans and a fixed predeclared landing schedule are supported. Pauses cannot introduce arbitrary observation targets; dense output, events, mass matrices and affine physical norms are outside this API.
nonblocking_limits.required_reporting: Do not equate bounded pause/resume with VODE-equivalent event or backward-integration support.

nonblocking_limits.detail: ensure_success preserves the method-specific partial trajectory but returns an error without the GeneralSelection wrapper. The caller can copy selection before consuming the result.
nonblocking_limits.next_step: Optionally add a result-carrying error variant in a later API revision if complete policy receipts must survive this conversion.

source_review.targeted_refresh: Reviewed session documentation clarification and native contains-to-binary-search edit after concurrent source changes; no new blocking defect found.

final_snapshot_refresh.review: Reread final selector/session and native binary-search plus explicit stop-reason documentation diffs. Selector formatting preserves decisions. Session scalar-atol telemetry expands to the physical dimension; callback, lifetime, accepted-state and terminal semantics unchanged. Current contract-test execution logs inspected without rerun.

limitations: This is not an exhaustive semantic audit of every ancestral change.
Ancestry proves commit inclusion, not immutability of all historical behaviors.
Source hashes identify the reviewed working snapshot; subsequent code edits require a targeted refresh.
Historical test counts and timings are not new observations.
No broad production qualification follows from this read-only audit.
